title: Pure physics model PhysKerr: FIR + nonlinear phase with memory (tens of multiplies instead of thousands)
git_commit: recorded per run in results/runs/*.json (field git_commit)
model: PhysKerr (src/constellation_denoiser/phys_models.py): u = F(z) complex FIR of length L inside the window (zero padding, unit-impulse init; L = 1: no FIR), y = u_c * exp(-i * sum_{j=-r..r} alpha_j |u_{c+j}|^2), r = (R-1)/2, alpha = 0 at start (identity model); sym: alpha_j = alpha_-j and h_j = h_-j (complex taps); complex MSE loss as complex_a
grid_note: (R = 1, L = 1) is identical for sym true/false and is trained once: 35 configurations
fir_only_note: linear FIR without nonlinearity (R = 0): lower bound
lr_branches: const_1e-3; best_e010_cm1 and best_e010_cm30 = experiments/E010_lr_schedule_study/results/stage3_choice.json['a'] (cosine_to_zero, peak 3e-3, warmup 0) with c_mult 1 or 30 for alpha; skipped without error if the file is missing
macs_phys: streaming count per symbol: FIR 4L (sym 2(L+1)), L = 1 -> 0; nonlinearity (R > 0): |u|^2 2 + power convolution R (sym (R+1)/2) + exp table 0 + rotation 4; see README for the comparison with the paper's 0.25(R+1)+6

metrics.main: test_reduction_valbest_select (test at the validation-best evaluation, every 1000 steps) and valbest_select_q2_gain_db
metrics.selection: mean over seeds of best_val_reduction (validation only)
metrics.seed_spread: range (max - min) over seeds; the larger range of the two compared groups

rule_draft.status: DRAFT: to be confirmed by the user before the first run; must not change after results are seen
rule_draft.physics_sufficient: the PhysKerr configuration (any lr branch) with the best mean validation reduction among those with multiplies <= 10% of 6480 (648) has a mean test reduction over the 5 seeds no worse than complex_a (const 1e-3, 20k, same 5 seeds) by more than 2 p.p.
rule_draft.physics_useful: reference = linear FIR + one Kerr coefficient (R = 1, L = 31, same sym, same lr branch); among configurations with R > 1 and multiplies <= the reference, the one with the best mean validation reduction beats the reference on test by >= 1 p.p. and by more than the seed spread
